subject.title: fix #100368: mark undelivered message_tool_only finals in replay

question: Should a hidden custom transcript notice become OpenClaw's canonical durable representation of an undelivered `message_tool_only` final across every runner path?
rationale: Even after repairing runner parity, this changes persisted model-consumed conversation history and therefore requires explicit acceptance of the long-term session-context semantics.

options.title: Adopt one durable marker
options.body: Persist the same guarded custom notice for direct and queued stranded finals and retain it through session rotation replay.

options.title: Design broader provenance
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a generalized delivery-provenance or non-persistent context representation instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt one durable marker
recommendation.body: Persist the same guarded custom notice for direct and queued stranded finals and retain it through session rotation replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and conflict-resolved the recovery implementation whose durable session semantics this PR extends.
